recipes.name: Easy Tortellini Salad
ingredients_raw: 1 (6 ounce) jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 (6 ounce) can sliced black olives, drained

steps.text: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in spinach and three-cheese tortellini and return to a boil. Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tortellini float to the top, pasta tender yet firm to the bite, and filling is hot, 10 to 11 minutes. Drain well; cool tortellini.
Combine tortellini, grape tomatoes, artichoke hearts, olives, red onion, and carrots in a large bowl; toss with dressing.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate until chilled, at least 3 hours to overnight.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Tortellini Salad
raw_recipe.description: This easy tortellini salad recipe has marinated artichoke hearts, tomatoes, olives, onion, carrots, and stuffed tortellini tossed in a vinaigrette dressing.

review.reviewBody: OMG!!! A friend of mine made this and brought it to my house warming party and everyone RAVED about how good it is!! You can pretty much add or remove whatever you like!! So GOOD!! We use the Cheese Fantastico dressing!! Super Delicious and SUPER EASY!!!

A+ salad! Instead of the spinach tortellini we added 2 packages of the tri-color cheese filled tortellini. Also topped it off with some feta cheese crumbles. We used a caesar vinaigrette dressing (that we had on hand) in place of the oil and vinegar - - added a nice flavor. Didn't have marinated artichokes so we used the plain ones. * * The key was to let it set at least 3 hours for all of the flavors to settle.

We Loved it--I did add sliced scallions, 1 lb. large shrimp-
cut in half, a 12 oz jar of artichokes & an 8 oz. tub of
shredded 3 cheese romano-parmesan-asiago mix. It was scrumptious!
Everyone Scarfed it down. You could use any meat or skip the meat,
or add a jar of pimentos or chopped red bell peppers & or
diced celery too. Very versitile!

I just used cheese tortellini from Trader Joe's and Vidalia onions and skipped the carrots (too lazy to grate them). This was phenomenal. People who claimed not to care for pasta salads loved it. I made the dressing with very high quality oil and vinegar, which brought this over the top. And it really was easy - it was a last minute addition to a party buffet based on things I had on hand.

This turned out really good and gets better the longer it sits. I wasn't able to find the dried spinach tortellini but I found a tri-color blend in the freezer section and cooked those according to the package directions. The one thing I will point out is that this is very olive forward. I love olives so it worked good for me but I'd cut back and use a 4 ounce can for a more even ratio. The reason I'm giving this 4 stars instead of 5 is because 1 1/2 cups of dressing would have been way too much. I started with 1 cup and wish I'd have used even less. Overall great recipe and one I'd make again with a couple of minor tweaks.

Loved it..the only change was dressing..evvo..balsamic..
parm.romano cheese.salt pepper italian seasoning..new into my rotation!!
Fantastic Salad for a hot summer day
It turned out great and was a hit with my family. I added fresh spinach which made it even more colorful.
Easy and delicious! It was a hit at the BBQ
Easy, delicious, a different take on pasta salad.
We served it for guest and they all enjoyed it. Then we took it to a group meeting and everyone liked it. We used Olive Garden Salad dressing.

This salad was wonderful. I brought it to an outdoor barbecue and everyone raved over it. I forgot the onions but maybe that was good for a crowd. I also added a can of hearts of palm and zucchini squash since I didn't have any spinach. I'm planning on making this again real soon!
I am a young married college student with a nutrition major and this was the perfect recipe for me and my husband!
This recipe is fantastic. I added shredded mozzarella cheese and thin slices of salami. I'm taking this to a baseball team party tonight.
Love this, added feta cheese crumbles and it was soooooo good!
